description: Fetch and validate a site's security.txt (RFC 9116) for vulnerability disclosure: tries /.well-known/security.txt then the legacy /security.txt (SSRF-safe), parses Contact / Expires / Encryption / Policy / Acknowledgments / Preferred-Languages / Canonical / Hiring / CSAF, handles PGP-signed files, and reports RFC errors (missing or expired Expires, non-URI contacts, wrong content type, http links, Canonical mismatch) with days until expiry. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/security-txt

domain.description: Domain or URL of the site

name: security_txt
